transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the FDA issued a warning letter regarding three efficacy claims on our consumer product website — 'reduces joint pain,' 'prevents migraines,' and 'boosts immunity.' I have final authority to approve the written response and its operational commitments, but per company policy, regulatory counsel and quality operations must confirm the legal response terms and operational controls before we submit anything. I'd like to start by hearing from regulatory counsel on their assessment of the claims and from quality operations on what operational controls we can realistically commit to. Let's work through this systematically.
